latency.method: nearest-rank p95 of per-pair (gateway RTT - direct RTT); pair order alternates; one outstanding request per lane
latency.exclusions: 30 warm-up pairs excluded. Difference removes matched upstream RTT approximately; network/scheduler jitter remains. Negative differences are retained.
